AC2_fixture_failure_explanation.classification: Not the cause. stg_001, rb_q2_2026, ev_001, dp_001 are baseline detail-or-alias routes with an entity endpoint, so honestNotFound applied and their entity 404 was excused.
AC2_fixture_failure_explanation.cause_viewer_only_read: RebalanceDetail, DeploymentDetail and EvolutionDetail call bffV1.approvals.list() whether or not the entity exists. As viewer, GET /bff/approvals returns 403 (operator-bff log: 403 GET /bff/approvals x10 during the crawl window). admintest has the approvals role, which is why the same pages showed no response >= 400 when opened as admintest. This is a real 403, not a misclassified honest not-found, so rb_q2_2026, rebalances/rb_q2_2026, ev_001 and dp_001 still fail (now naming GET /bff/approvals 403) until MGMT-VIEWER-APPROVALS-READ-20261126 lands or the pages stop issuing the read.
AC2_fixture_failure_explanation.cause_stream_409: Every management page opens GET /bff/events/stream via PlatformShell. The BFF answers 409 replay_unavailable when the Last-Event-ID is outside its replay window, and the FE handles it (liveSse fetchSse drops the id and reconnects). The crawl counted every attributed BFF response >= 400, including this stream 409, as api_data_failure. StrategyDetail issues only GET /bff/strategies/stg_001 (404) before a strategy loads (its approvals section is gated on a loaded strategy), so for stg_001 the 409 stream response (x35 in the window) was the only remaining >= 400 response. This was the misclassification; it is fixed by the explicit stream rule.
AC2_fixture_failure_explanation.fix_scope: Only the stream 409 is excused, by an explicit rule. Honest-not-found classification, the 404 rule and all other data checks are unchanged.
AC2_fixture_failure_explanation.caveat: Inferred from FE source and the operator-bff log, not from a per-read hosted artifact; no hosted crawl ran in this task (no viewer token here). The next release crawl records failedReads and will confirm or refute it per route.

residual_findings: Viewer 403 on GET /bff/approvals: RebalanceDetail, DeploymentDetail, EvolutionDetail and CapitalPoolDetail (and the approvals/governance/runtimes pages) issue the approvals read as viewer. Tracked by MGMT-VIEWER-APPROVALS-READ-20261126; these routes keep failing until that lands. Alternatively, detail pages could skip reads the role cannot perform.

GET /bff/events/stream 409 x35 in a 17-minute crawl: frequent replay_unavailable suggests reconnects carry a Last-Event-ID that the serving replica's in-memory replay buffer does not hold (multi-replica or restarted buffer), or a client-generated realtime id (useLiveList passes realtime.getLastEventId(), which can be a locally generated bus id). The client recovers, but it is a reconnect storm worth a product follow-up.

503 GET /bff/management/persona-fleet and 503 GET /bff/management/human-inbox/readiness_blocker%3A... under crawl load: real BFF availability defects, not crawl misclassification; still fail and are now named per route.
/management/risk loading_unresolved + data_reads_incomplete: failedReads will now name the pending read (pending_response/pending_body) on the next run.

Pantheon acceptance stage summary (acceptance-crawl.json) copies only route + reason flags; it should copy routes[].failedReads from the FE crawl JSON to surface the detail in the release artifact (Pantheon-side follow-up, out of this repo).
